newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Moody's upgrades Skandia to A3 from Baa1.
newsitem.headline: Moody's upgrades Skandia to A3 from Baa1.

text.p: U.S. credit ratings agency Moody's said on Thursday it upgraded Swedish insurer Skandia's financial strength rating to A3 from Baa1 and its subordinated debt rating to Baa2 from Baa3.
The agency confirmed the Prime-2 short-term debt rating on the commercial paper programme of Skandia International Capital Corp.

"These rating actions reflect Moody's view that extensive restructuring, provisioning and investment in core operations, as well as the success of the unit-linked life assurance subsidiaries of the group have enhanced Skandia's profitability prospects," Moody's said in a statement.
The agency said it believed Skandia could enjoy substantial profit streams from its unit-linked business in the future.

However on the negative side, Moody's noted Skandia's high financial leverage, which could constrain its ability to expand its unit-linked business and to participate in the currenct consolidation of the financial sector in the Nordic region.
This constraint is expected to affect Skandia over the medium term, it said.
